intro.text: The generator should distribute weekly work by muscle group, exercise tolerance, available sessions and recovery. A commonly used starting point for an adult without special constraints is roughly 6–10 challenging weekly sets per target muscle for a novice-to-intermediate plan, then adjust according to response; the 2026 ACSM overview identifies ≥10 weekly sets as a volume associated with greater hypertrophy in its synthesis. These figures should not be treated as a hard threshold, and indirect work from compound lifts complicates counting. [S01] [S11]
